Live Lightning Utility API — pay-per-call Bitcoin & Lightning data via x402 (USDC on Base) and L402 (sats). No API keys. No accounts. sh.001/call.

Endpoints:
• Invoice decode — BOLT11 parsing
• Fee estimates — mempool.space real-time
• Route queries — mainnet LND node
• Network data — BTC price, difficulty, LN stats
• Node status — channels, balances, forwarding

Built on a Raspberry Pi Umbrel node. Mainnet since Feb 2026.

Docs: https://dispatches.mystere.me/docs

If you're building agents that need Bitcoin data, this removes all signup/API key friction. Your agent pays per call. That's it.

The protocol every execution system speaks before capital moves.

Before any swap, route, or on-chain tx:

→ Risk distribution is mapped: liquidity / slippage / routing / oracle
→ Policy decision: EXECUTE · WARN · BLOCK

Not a DEX. Not an oracle.
A decision layer between intent and execution.

Three-layer architecture:
L1 — Data (pools, mempool, oracles)
L2 — Intelligence (FW_CONSENSUS · FW_SIM · FW_LIQ · probability model)
L3 — Policy (configurable per caller: dex / bot / agent)

Every verdict is cryptographically anchored.
Every prediction is measured against on-chain reality.
